```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# 1. Load the data (ensure the filename matches your actual file)
fit_data <- read.table("fit.txt", header = TRUE, sep="", fill=TRUE)

# 2. Convert 'event' to a numeric indicator for R (y = 1, n = 0)
fit_data$event_num <- ifelse(fit_data$event == "y", 1, 0)

# 3. Create the survival object and fit the model stratified by Node
# Node 2 = Unmutated, Node 3 = Mutated
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(observed, event_num) ~ node, data = fit_data)

# 4. Generate the Kaplan-Meier Plot
ggsurvplot(
  km_fit,
  data = fit_data,
  xlim = c(0, 60),               # Limit X-axis to your 5-year window
  ylim = c(0.5, 1),              # Median survival was 60+, so zoom in on top half
  xlab = "Observed Months",
  ylab = "Survival Probability",
  legend.labs = c("All Patients (Node 1)"),
  palette = c("#E7B800"), # Distinct colors for the groups
  ggtheme = theme_minimal()
)
```
